title: EAUM size spectrum
note: Investor counts by reported matched-CUSIP equity exposure. Each investor appears once.

title: Largest disclosed portfolios
note: Ranked reported equity exposure; values are not combined across managers.

title: Capital percentile ladder
note: Interpolated percentiles of investor equity exposure, including zero exposures.

title: Median capital by breadth
note: Median investor exposure in each distinct-CUSIP count band.

title: Mean disclosed position size
note: Reported equity exposure divided by distinct CUSIPs; not a typical trade size.

title: Capital above each threshold
note: Cumulative investor counts at or above each EAUM threshold.

title: Upper-quartile capital by size
note: 75th percentile of investor exposure within each size band.

title: Capital dispersion by breadth
note: Interquartile range of investor equity exposure in each breadth band.

title: Sub-billion investor landscape
note: Investors with reported equity exposure below $1bn, largest first.

title: Billion-dollar investor breadth
note: Distinct CUSIPs among investors reporting at least $1bn.

title: Portfolio breadth spectrum
note: Investor counts by distinct-CUSIP count. CUSIPs are securities, not issuer counts.

title: Broadest portfolios
note: Ranked distinct-CUSIP counts at one exact reporting date.

title: Most focused positive portfolios
note: Smallest nonzero distinct-CUSIP counts; this does not infer style.

title: Breadth percentile ladder
note: Interpolated percentiles of distinct-CUSIP counts.

title: Median breadth by capital band
note: Median security count for each investor exposure band.

title: Breadth above each threshold
note: Cumulative count of investors at or above each security-count threshold.

title: Focused capital leaders
note: Largest equity exposures among portfolios holding 1–25 distinct CUSIPs.

title: Diversified capital leaders
note: Largest equity exposures among portfolios holding at least 500 CUSIPs.

title: Breadth dispersion by capital
note: Interquartile range of distinct-CUSIP counts within each exposure band.

title: Securities per billion disclosed
note: Distinct-CUSIP count divided by reported exposure in billions; zero exposures excluded.

title: Common cohort value increases
note: Same entity at both dates. Reported value change includes prices and disclosure effects; not flows.

title: Common cohort value decreases
note: Same entity at both dates. Negative changes are reported exposure changes, not estimated selling.

title: Common cohort relative growth
note: (Current/prior equity exposure − 1), excluding zero prior exposure.

title: Common cohort relative contraction
note: Smallest relative equity exposure changes among matched entities with positive prior values.

title: Portfolio breadth expansion
note: Change in distinct-CUSIP count, not a count of purchases.

title: Portfolio breadth contraction
note: Change in distinct-CUSIP count, not a count of sold positions.

title: Capital direction × breadth direction
note: Matched entities grouped by the sign of exposure and CUSIP-count changes.

title: Reporting cohort bridge
note: Presence in the selected caches, not new fund launches, closures or first-time filers.

title: Capital size-band migration
note: Matched entities moving between the fixed exposure bands used in view 01.

title: Median exposure change by prior size
note: Median dollar change for common entities grouped by their prior exposure band.

title: Most widely held sample securities
note: Distinct validated manager holders per CUSIP in the fixed largest-50 candidate sample.

title: Sample holder-count spectrum
note: Security counts by number of distinct validated sample managers holding each CUSIP.

title: Highest mean holder commitment
note: Mean within-portfolio security weight among sample managers holding that CUSIP.

title: Largest single-holder commitment
note: Maximum within-portfolio security weight among validated sample holders.

title: Broad conviction securities
note: Mean portfolio weight among sample holders, restricted to at least 10 sample holders.

title: Single-holder sample discoveries
note: Securities with exactly one holder in this sample, ranked by that portfolio weight.

title: Top-position concentration
note: Largest security weight in each validated sampled portfolio.

title: Top-five concentration
note: Sum of five largest CUSIP weights within each validated sampled portfolio.

title: Top-ten concentration
note: Sum of ten largest CUSIP weights within each validated sampled portfolio.

title: Effective holdings count
note: 1 / sum of squared security weights within each validated sampled portfolio. Equal weights yield the actual holdings count.

title: Filing-lag spectrum
note: Days from report date to latest selected filing date; missing dates excluded. Not ingestion latency.

title: Longest selected filing lags
note: Latest selected filing date minus report date, including selected later amendments.

title: Selected source-version spectrum
note: Counts of entities by number of selected source accessions.

title: Excluded position reasons
note: Counts of source position rows excluded by reconciliation reason; one row may be subject to the source exclusion rules.

title: Largest exclusion burdens
note: Excluded source position-row counts per entity; not dollar exposure excluded.

title: Clean versus excluded-row entities
note: Entities with any recorded excluded rows versus none. This is not an overall quality certification.

title: Published reporting-date coverage
note: Cached entity counts by exact report date. Coverage changes are not changes in the investor population.

title: Blocked source selections
note: Selections withheld by source reconciliation at this lens and date, grouped by reason.

title: Selected accession form mix
note: Source-version counts by form across the selected entities, not counts of unique investors.

title: Source chronology completeness
note: Selected source versions with explicit timestamps versus missing fields. Each metric is independent.
